caption: The drawing features a pattern composed of stylized leafy forms and curvilinear branches set against a light blue-green background. The leaves are predominantly white with green interiors and dark green, red, and black vein-like details. The branches, in shades of light beige and gray, weave throughout the design, with smaller offshoots creating intricate connections between the leaves. Small red dots and short dashes are scattered across the background, adding texture and depth. The overall composition is rectangular, centered within a blank cream-colored mat, with the pattern evenly distributed and repeated, giving a sense of continuity throughout the central area.
title: Wall Paper
